data.description: 【西连寺春菜 · 晨光窗边的白衬衫与羞涩回眸】清晨微风轻拂窗纱，百叶窗的金色晨光在地板上映出一道道暖影。春菜套着略显宽松的白衬衫，两只长袖垂在手边，侧身站在窗前。察觉到视线，她双手护在身前轻拢衣襟，回头望来，整张清秀面庞泛起动人的羞涩红晕。
data.promptProse: Standing in profile beside the sunlit bedroom window with sheer white curtains stirring in the morning breeze, Haruna clutches the draped white shirt close to her chest with both hands. Warm diagonal sunbeams rim her shoulder and hair as she turns to glance back at the viewer with an endearing, flushed blush.
data.animaCaption: Both hands hold the draped shirt against her chest.
